name: Velinde Starsong
summary: In Ashenvale, Melyria Frostshadow seeks word of the commander who came before her. Velinde Starsong vanished while fighting the corruption spreading from Felwood, and Melyria sends you to Darnassus for answers.

sections.title: A Vanished Predecessor
sections.body: Melyria Frostshadow keeps watch in Ashenvale, following Velinde Starsong, who once held the same post. A priestess, Velinde was charged with containing demonic corruption spreading south from Felwood. Early reports said she had the danger under control, but her campaign faltered over time. Then she vanished without warning or formal relief, leaving the fight unfinished and her fate unknown.

sections.title: Secrets of the Terrace
sections.body: Disturbing clues in the forest lead Melyria to send you to Darnassus. On the Warrior's Terrace, Sentinel commander Thyn'tel Bladeweaver oversees military deployments. The Sentinels know Velinde disappeared, but her command keeps the circumstances close. Thyn'tel will need persuading before sharing any deeper records.

faq.answer: Velinde Starsong was a priestess and Sentinel commander stationed in Ashenvale. She was charged with holding the northern border against demonic horrors from Felwood, then vanished from duty.

faq.q: Why is Sentinel Melyria asking about her now?
faq.answer: Melyria Frostshadow took Velinde's place after she disappeared. Discoveries in the Howling Vale have renewed her concern for what happened and for Ashenvale's safety.

faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete this quest?
aliases: where to turn in velinde starsong
faq.answer: Travel from Ashenvale to Darnassus, atop Teldrassil. Commander Thyn'tel Bladeweaver is stationed on the Warrior's Terrace.

faq.q: Why is Commander Bladeweaver reluctant to talk?
faq.answer: The Sentinels know Velinde went missing, but the details of her final missions are sensitive military matters. Darnassus's leaders do not share them lightly with outsiders.

faq.q: What connection does Velinde have to Felwood?
faq.answer: Velinde led the Sentinels' effort to contain demonic corruption spreading from Felwood. Her campaign faltered after early success, shortly before she vanished.

faq.q: What quest leads directly into this one?
faq.answer: This follows The Howling Vale, where you investigate strange and hostile events deep in Ashenvale's forests.

angles.text: As a night elf defender, you face the fate of a respected commander and priestess amid northern Kalimdor's fragile state after the Third War.
As a priest of Elune, you may feel a kinship with a sister of the faith who fought to stem the demonic corruption from Felwood.
As an Alliance member, you see Darnassus's strict military protocol, which keeps battlefield disappearances within the Sentinel command.
